author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using 2-inch KERDI-BOARD to build this small shower curb. I bond it to the tray, floor, and wall with ALL-SET mortar. Then I waterproof it with banding and prefab corners. This finished curb can support any size shower door. Many thanks to Schluter for sponsoring this tutorial and providing materials for my client’s renovation
title: Small Schluter Shower Curb Tips - #shorts #showerremodel #sponsored
